All phases are complete. Summary:

**Phase A — Live intake** (`release-lab/intake.md`)
- UTC: 2026-08-06 20:04:59 (shell clock)
- Latest stable Rust: **1.97.1** — [Rust Blog](https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/07/09/Rust-1.97.1/)
- Cloudflare: **No active incident** (All Systems Operational) — [cloudflarestatus.com](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/)
- CNCF headline: [CNCF Strengthens Partnership with Broadcom as a Platinum Member to Advance AI-Ready Cloud Native Infrastructure](https://www.cncf.io/announcements/2026/07/16/cncf-strengthens-partnership-with-broadcom-as-a-platinum-member-to-to-advance-ai-ready-cloud-native-infrastructure/)
- Tokyo: 19°C, rain, high 22°/low 19°, as of 08:09 JST — [weather.com](https://weather.com/en/weather/today/l/506b6438ed491e9cbe5fa3a054316fdfc7ecd696e5529caee9356099a5df4534)

**Phase B — Local fixtures**: `manifest-a.json` (40 alpha), `manifest-b.json` (A010/A020/A030 → beta), `diff.json` (count_a=40, count_b=40, changed_ids=[A010,A020,A030], changed_count=3, sha256 both verified), `README.md` (11 lines).

**Phase C — Transform**: `scripts/build-brief.ps1` reads diff.json + intake.md → `out/brief.txt` with `changed_count=3`, `rust_stable=1.97.1`, `tokyo_weather=19°C, rain…`. Added `"note":"rechecked"` to diff.json and re-ran — brief.txt regenerated (mtime advanced, content confirmed).

**Phase D — Closeout**: `report.md` written with pass/fail per item, tools used (web_search for live, PowerShell/apply_patch for local), and 2 recoveries (Tokyo extraction field fix; UTF-8 encoding fix for `°`). Final on-disk verification passed.

RELEASE_LAB_COMPLETE
